title: Spreading local contraction data with free complements
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a prime, and X,Y,Z finite free R-modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let a:X→Y and b:Y→Z satisfy b∘a=0. Set L=R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]; scalar extensions are [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Suppose L-linear maps s:Y_L→X_L and t:Z_L→Y_L satisfy a_L∘s+t∘b_L=1. There is f outside p and maps s_f:Y_f→X_f, t_f:Z_f→Y_f over R_f [def-weil-ring-localization-away] satisfying a_f∘s_f∘a_f=a_f, t_f∘b_f∘t_f=t_f and a_f∘s_f+t_f∘b_f=1, for which ker(s_f∘a_f) and ker(b_f∘t_f) are free. No residue-field criterion, complex, or homotopy is asserted.

proof.text: Use finite presentation of Y and Z to lift s and t from R_p after multiplying by denominators. Multiply the two lifts by the other denominator to obtain a common denominator c. The local middle identity implies that a s0+t0 b and c times identity have the same localization. Finiteness of Y gives one more element d outside p killing this error. Scaling both lifts by d gives actual R-linear maps satisfying a s0+t0 b=f times identity with f=dc outside p.

proof.text: From ba=0 and the scaled middle identity, q=s0 a on X and r=b t0 on Z satisfy q squared=fq and r squared=fr. For a scaled projector q, set C=coker q, which is finitely presented because the source and target are finite free. Over any R-algebra in which f is a unit, the map 1-q/f is a surjective projection to ker q whose kernel is range q; right exactness of tensor identifies the base change of C with this kernel.

proof.text: At p the normalized projector q/f is idempotent. The proved LinearMap.free_and_finite_ker_of_isIdempotentElem makes its kernel free over R_p, and hence C localized at p is free. Apply Module.FinitePresentation.exists_free_localizedModule_powers to C. Apply it separately to q and r, obtaining g1 and g2 outside p. Base change the resulting free cokernels to R localized at f g1 g2; the cokernel-kernel equivalences make both unnormalized projector kernels free there.

proof.text: Divide s0,t0 by the unit f to obtain a s+t b=1. The equation ba=0 gives a s a=a and b t b=b. Replace t by t b t, giving t b t=t and preserving the middle identity and b t. Multiplication by the inverse of f does not change the kernels. Explicit tensor-to-categorical-scalar-extension equivalences conjugate the maps and restrict to equivalences of their kernels. This proves every asserted equation and freeness clause. Empty bases and zero cokernels are covered by these constructions.

theorem exists_principal_contraction_of_atPrime
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (X Y Z : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (a : X ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ Z) (hab : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hX : Module.Free R X) (hY : Module.Free R Y) (hZ : Module.Free R Z)
    (hfX : Module.Finite R X) (hfY : Module.Finite R Y) (hfZ : Module.Finite R Z)
    (s : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, max u v}
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))).obj Y ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, max u v}
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))).obj X)
    (t : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, max u v}
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))).obj Z ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, max u v}
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))).obj Y)
    (hmid : s ≫ (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))).map a +
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))).map b ≫ t =
        𝟙 ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))).obj Y)) :
    ∃ f : R, f ∉ p ∧
      let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, max u v} (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f))
      ∃ (s : E.obj Y ⟶ E.obj X) (t : E.obj Z ⟶ E.obj Y),
        E.map a ≫ s ≫ E.map a = E.map a ∧
        t ≫ E.map b ≫ t = t ∧
        s ≫ E.map a + E.map b ≫ t = 𝟙 (E.obj Y) ∧
        Module.Free (Localization.Away f) (LinearMap.ker (E.map a ≫ s).hom) ∧
        Module.Free (Localization.Away f) (LinearMap.ker (t ≫ E.map b).hom)
